THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON (1956 REVISED EDITION)
Revocation Of Order Under Section 4(1)

WHEREAS by Order made under Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (Revised Edition 1956) as amended by Acts. No. 14 and 62 of 1957,14 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 read with Industrial Disputes (Special Provisions) Act No. 37 of 1968 dated 15.12.2023 and published in the Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka Extraordinary No 2363/70 dated 22.12.2023 the Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter speciﬁ ed in the statement of the Commissioner General of Labour dated 29.11.2023.
Mr. P.G. Nandana Kumara Bandara,Wambatuyaya,Hunganwela,Nalanda. of the one part and
Sri Lanka Transport Board,No.200,Kirula Road,Colombo - 05. of the other part

AND whereas it is deemed expedient that the said Order be revoked, due to Mr. Janajith De Silva, Attorney-at-Law, the Arbitrator informing that he is resigning from the post of arbitrator, I Dr. Harini Amarasuriya, Minister of Justice, Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Council, Local Government and Labour do hereby revoke the said Order and further make Order that no proceeding be taken upon the said Order dated 15.12.2023.
DR.HARINI AMARASURIYA, Minister of Justice, Public Administration Home Affairs, Provincial Councils, Local Government and Labour.1st November 2024.Colombo.

STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTEThe matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether Mr. P.G. Nandana Kumara Bandara who had worked at the Regional workshop, Kaludewala, Matale of the Sri Lanka Transport Board had been caused injustice by the non-payment of salary from 13.10.2008 to 07.03.2015, the period during which he had been interdicted, and if so, to what relief he is entitled.
